name: South Side Training Ride
schedule: Saturdays through October 31, 2026, 8:00 am from the shop; A, B and C groups
pace: A: 32+ mi at 20+ mph. B: 28+ mi at 16-18 mph. C: 24+ mi at 13-15 mph

host.name: South Side Cyclery / South Side Cycling Club

visitor_notes: Free, but a waiver is required (link on the page). A and B riders can drop back a group if needed; there is no designated sweep, so bring the route from the club's Strava page and be ready to navigate.
description: A coached training ride out of the shop. Riders get in-ride coaching on holding momentum over rolling hills, riding a paceline, cornering and timing an attack. Training efforts happen at River City Casino and Jefferson Barracks Park, then a steady tempo ride back to the shop.
evidence: South Side Cyclery's rides page lists 'South Side Training Rides: Saturdays through October 31st @ 8am' with A, B and C groups, next to Wednesday dates (Apr 1 to Oct 28, Nov 11 to Mar 17) that match the 2026 calendar (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page switches to winter Saturday coffee and conditioning rides after Oct 31; re-read it in November.

name: Big Shark Long Route Shop Ride

start_location.name: Big Shark Bicycle Company, Big Bend
start_location.address: 1155 S Big Bend Blvd, Richmond Heights, MO 63117

visitor_notes: Road bikes encouraged. Helmet required, no earbuds. From Nov 1 to Mar 1 there is no ride leader and routes change.
description: The faster of Big Shark's Saturday road options: a slightly rolling 31-mile loop at 16 to 19 mph. A medium and a short route leave at the same time. The shop calls these no-attack rides: you start and finish together.
